messages:
Clara (CS Ops): noticed spike in 'at-risk' flips for week-0 accounts after the recent scoring model swap. about 210 accounts flipped, many with no contact changes.
Vik (CRM): thanks. could be the demographic weight change that treats company_size null as 0. saw similar a month ago.
June (Data): dropping quick query now to check which feature moved most:
June (Data): ```sql
select account_id, created_at, health_v4, company_size, last_contact_ts
from account_metrics
where created_at > now() - interval '14 days'
order by created_at desc
limit 300;
```
Clara (CS Ops): i'd prefer a conservative circuit-breaker instead of immediate rollback: sample 8% of affected accounts, disable auto-escalations for them, add tag `circuit:health-guard`, and hold renewal nudges for 72h.
Ira (Enablement): agree. avoids noisy outreach and gives CS time to triage owners. can we also surface top 30 likely false-positives to owners?
playbook-bot: created run id cb-1758881 1: status queued. (/playbooks/run cb-1758881) :gear:
Vik (CRM): i'll patch mapping so null company_size maps to 'unknown' and scoring treats 'unknown' as previous value. will gate behind ff `scoring.null_safe`.
June (Data): sampling done: 17% of sampled accounts show company_size null, 63% show old last_contact overwritten by webhook backfill, rest are low-activity. uploading CSV to /shared/cs/cb-1758881.csv
Clara (CS Ops): can admin console expose a run toggle so CS leads can flip the hold per cohort? avoid ops handoffs.
Vik (CRM): done: admin.playbooks.hold_run=cb-1758881. runbook snippet: 
Vik (CRM): ```yaml
run_id: cb-1758881
sample_rate: 0.08
actions:
  - pause_auto_escalations: true
  - suppress_renewal_nudges: 72h
  - add_tags: [circuit:health-guard, cs:manual-review]
  - notify: cs-leads@redwood.com
```
playbook-bot: cb-1758881 moved to in-progress 1: safeguard enacted for sampled cohort. :white_check_mark:
Ira (Enablement): i'll draft a 2-line owner template and post it here.
Clara (CS Ops): next steps: June posts full CSV and metric delta, Vik deploys ff to staging, Ira readies owner outreach, and i'll run triage tomorrow 09:30 PT. tagging @channel for visibility.
